item.content:encoded: I don't know when the most recent rate for this came in, but, (and I hate to make this discussion sound like a broken record, but here it is) this needs to be read by more people. It shows you how older tales were written, it actually gives characterization to the two researchers, it has comedy, it has horror, and it takes significantly less than ten minutes to read it and rate it. Come on, people!

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I just fucking love this story so goddamn much.

Seriously, this has got to be one of my favorite stories anyone has written on this entire website. Of every story troy, djoric, dmatix, and all those other tale masters, this one is at the top of the heap. It's just so perfect. It's exactly the right length for what it is, the prose is wonderful, and the dialog manages to be funny, deep, and totally right for the characters all at the same time.

This is a story I come back to every now and then to remind myself what this wiki is all about. It's perfect. If you're looking at recent posts, and are seeing this glowing review and thinking 'what could possibly earn this praise' I demand you come read this criminally underrated story.
